prompt_text: Which title company in Fort Lauderdale FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” title company, but **Independence Title** looks like a strong starting point: the available results show a **4.9-star rating across roughly 476 reviews**, with reviewers often praising communication and attention to detail. [Reviews](https://reviews.birdeye.com/independence-title-147128886737611?page=10) · [Yelp](https://www.yelp.com/biz/independence-title-fort-lauderdale)

Also worth comparing:
- **Independent Title of Fort Lauderdale** — 4.8 stars across 98 reviews, including positive feedback about residential closings. [Reviews](https://reviews.birdeye.com/independent-title-of-fort-lauderdale-170408501010792)
- **Palm Title** — Fort Lauderdale-based, with testimonials describing smooth residential closings. [Website](https://palmtitle.com/)

Before choosing, ask for a written estimate of title and closing fees, confirm they regularly handle your type of transaction, and check that your lender will work with them. You can also verify the agency or agent through Florida’s [license lookup](https://licenseesearch.fldfs.com/).
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
